attestation.note: SIMULATED: signing key is a local file, not bound to hardware. Production: key generated inside a confidential VM / H100 CC / AWS Nitro enclave, with an attestation report binding the public key to the measured training code.

claim: Serving model f64422dbc9d51001ba5fbf12961a7e2c334af892ee38d5bf7fa4bd7fed21adaa was produced by signed training runs whose manifests exclude all 190 records of source tenant:acme (Merkle root 9bffcb11f4336c08c62f57f4eeb4d6c8752db9791a6ea9ea60c7cdaa4f0a0bee, as registered at ledger seq 1). Removal tier: exact shard retrain. Empirical audit: canary exposure 0.22 bits vs control baseline 0.78 bits.
out_of_scope: Copies outside the training pipeline (raw data stores, backups, logs, caches, analytics exports, and any outputs/completions already served) are not covered by this certificate.

Trust in attestation hardware: this build uses SIMULATED_TEE_ATTESTATION -- a local ed25519 key file, not a hardware-bound key. Whoever holds the key can sign. Production binds the key to measured code in a confidential VM (H100 CC on GCP/Azure) or AWS Nitro enclave.
Root models listed in lineage.root_models have no recorded training run in this ledger; they are assumed to be trained on generic, source-free text.
The canary-exposure audit is empirical evidence, not a proof; the exactness claim rests on the signed manifests and non-membership proofs.
Record hashes are unsalted sha256 commitments; low-entropy records could be guessed from their hashes.
Non-membership soundness assumes manifests are sorted Merkle trees built by the (attested) pipeline; anyone holding a manifest's leaves can re-check it by recomputing the root.
Models deployed before the revocation, and anything they produced, are not covered; the claim is about the serving model hash stated here.
Exclusion is of these exact record hashes (sha256 of the NFC-normalised canonical record); the same or near-duplicate content stored under other records or sources is not covered.
The covered record set is the one registered for this source at the ledger seq stated in the claim; records never registered under this source are not covered.

Signatures and proofs do not stop a key holder who controls the pipeline from committing an unsorted manifest; detecting that requires the manifest leaves (manifest_leaves_recomputed check) or hardware attestation.
